To hand over India to Japan

Merger of princely states into India

Complete merger of the princely states
Granting complete independence to India immediately

Freedom of speech and protest against the war

Appointment of Indian Prime Minister in Britain

Reasons for dissolution of ministries by the British
On Gandhiji's orders to start individual Satyagraha

Because Jinnah had withdrawn the demand

Nomination by the British Government only

Only the Samajwadi faction had chosen him

question: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of Cabinet Mission?

question: On what was the election manifesto of the Congress during the 1937 elections based?

question: Who was named as the first Satyagrahi by Mahatma Gandhi during Individual Satyagraha?

question: In which language did Gandhiji give the message of 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement?

question: Who was the head of the parallel government in 'Ballia' during the Quit India Movement?

question: Which organization was founded by Mahatma Gandhi after the Poona Pact?

question: What did Subhash Chandra Bose address Gandhiji on Rangoon Radio for 'Azad Hind Fauj'?

question: Who was the first chairman of 'National Planning Committee' (1938)?

solution: This temporary government was recognized by nine countries, including Japan, Germany and Italy. This government also had its own flag, army and bank.

question: Which country was not included in the 'Axis Powers' during World War II?
solution: The goal of the Axis powers was to establish their totalitarian rule over the world, while the Allies (Britain, Russia, America) were fighting against them.

question: What type of administrative structure did the Cabinet Mission Plan propose for India?
solution: According to the Cabinet Mission the provinces were divided into three groups – A (Hindu majority), B (Muslim majority – North West) and C (Muslim majority – North East).

question: What was the main reason for public sympathy towards INA soldiers in the Red Fort trial?
options: The British government's oppression of them
They were representatives of all religions
He was considered a patriot and Indian freedom fighter.
solution: The INA Trial brought all the communities of India together on one platform. Both Muslim League and Congress had demonstrated in support of these soldiers.

question: What was the biggest feature of the Faizpur session of 1937?
options: This was the first session to be held in a village
The tricolor was hoisted here for the first time
solution: Nehru tried to take the social and economic programs of Congress to rural India through this convention.

question: Who was the first education minister of independent India?
solution: In honor of Maulana Azad, his birthday (11 November) is celebrated as 'National Education Day'. He was one of the youngest and longest serving presidents of the Congress.

question: What was the famous slogan of the public outside 'Red Fort' during the INA trial?
options: Voice from Red Fort - Sehgal, Dhillon, Shah Nawaz
solution: The INA trial also created a wave of patriotism within the Indian Army, making the British realize that now an army mutiny could happen at any time.

question: What was the main promise made in the 'August Offer' given by Lord Linlithgow in 1940?
solution: Jawaharlal Nehru had described the August Resolution as 'a rusty nail stuck in the door'. The Congress completely rejected this as their goal was now complete Swaraj.

question: Who was the revolutionary who handed over the leadership of 'Azad Hind Fauj' to Subhash Chandra Bose?
solution: Rash Bihari Bose, due to his advancing age and declining health, handed over the leadership to Subhash Chandra Bose, whom he considered his rightful successor.

question: Which Viceroy organized the Shimla Conference of 1945 to break the political deadlock?
solution: The Simla Conference failed because Jinnah was adamant that all Muslim members of the Working Committee would be nominated by the Muslim League only.

question: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress at the time of India's independence?
solution: Kripalani was a prominent Gandhian leader. Soon after independence he resigned due to differences within the Congress.

question: By whom was the slogan 'Quit India' originally coined?
solution: Yusuf Mehar Ali also coined the slogan 'Simon go back'. He was also the Mayor of Bombay and played an active role in the movements.

question: Who started Satyagraha from 'Paunar Ashram' during Individual Satyagraha?
solution: Vinoba Bhave was considered the spiritual successor of Gandhiji. His Satyagraha had strengthened the Gandhian ideology in rural areas.

question: Why did Mountbatten choose the date '15 August 1947' for the partition of India?
options: Being the second anniversary of Japan's surrender in World War II, Mountbatten considered this day auspicious for his career as he was the head of the South-East Asia Command.
It was a Hindu festival day
It was an order of the British Parliament.
solution: Choosing the date of August 15 left little administrative time, leading to a complete breakdown of the arrangements made during Partition and increased violence.

question: Who was the Chairman of the Cabinet Mission sent to India in 1946?
solution: The Cabinet Mission had proposed a federal union and classification of provinces into three groups. It rejected the demand for a separate Pakistan but provided a flexible arrangement through grouping of provinces.

question: On which date is Subhash Chandra Bose considered to have died in a plane crash?
solution: Several inquiry commissions (Shah Nawaz, Khosla and Mukherjee Commissions) were formed regarding Bose's death. Most confirmed the plane crash but the mystery still persists.

question: By what name did Subhash Chandra Bose form the famous 'Free India Legion' in Germany?
solution: Bose traveled in Germany under the pseudonym of 'Orlando Mazzotta'. He had sought support from Hitler for India's independence.

question: Who was the first Defense Minister of independent India?
solution: Baldev Singh was a prominent Sikh leader of Punjab. His appointment represented the important position of the Sikhs in the army and national unity.

question: Who was the Vice President of the Interim Government (1946)?
solution: The purpose of the interim government was to administer the country during the transfer of power and to help in the formation of the Constituent Assembly. Initially Muslim League did not join it but later joined.

question: What was the age of 'Martyr Kanaklata Barua' when he was shot during the Quit India Movement?
solution: Kanaklata Barua was part of a group called 'Mrityu Vahini'. His martyrdom is still considered a symbol of patriotism in Assam.

question: In which province did Congress fail to form government in the 1937 elections?
solution: Apart from Bengal, non-Congress governments were also formed in Punjab and Sindh. Unionist Party came to power in Punjab and United Party in Sindh.

question: For how many months was Vinoba Bhave sentenced during Individual Satyagraha?
solution: Satyagrahis were instructed to inform the police about their activities in advance. This was a moral war in which violence had no place.

question: Which annual session of Congress was presided over by Subhash Chandra Bose in 1938?
solution: During the Haripura session of 1938, the National Planning Committee was formed under the leadership of Subhash Chandra Bose, of which Jawaharlal Nehru was made the first chairman. It was from here that ideological differences started appearing between Bose and Gandhi.

question: The formation of which institution was accepted for the first time in the 'August Resolution'?
solution: Although Congress had been making this demand for a long time, the British accepted it officially only in 1940.

question: Who was the British Prime Minister at the time of India's independence?
solution: Clement Attlee had sent Lord Mountbatten as the last Viceroy of India so that he could rapidly complete the process of transfer of power.
